description: scATAC-seq Level 1 data - Raw sequencing files and metadata

CRYOPRESERVED_CELLS_IN_SAMPLE.description: Whether cells were cryopreserved in the sample

DISSOCIATION_METHOD.description: Method used to dissociate tissue into single cells
DISSOCIATION_METHOD.title: DissociationMethodEnum

FILENAME.description: Name of the file. Must end with an extension matching the FILE_FORMAT (.fastq for fastq; .fastq.gz or .fq.gz for fastq.gz)

FILE_FORMAT.description: Format of the raw sequencing file (fastq or fastq.gz)

HTAN_PARENT_ID.description: HTAN Parent ID(s) - Foreign key(s) to parent entity (B for Biospecimen, D for data file). One or more IDs; for aggregated files provide multiple. Each ID must have B or D suffix. Supports HTA200-229 for phase 2.

LIBRARY_CONSTRUCTION_METHOD.description: Method used to construct the sequencing library
LIBRARY_CONSTRUCTION_METHOD.title: LibraryConstructionMethodEnum

LIBRARY_PREPARATION_DAYS_FROM_INDEX.description: Number of days between when the sample for assay was received in the lab and the libraries were prepared for sequencing. If not applicable please enter 'Not Applicable')

NUCLEIC_ACID_SOURCE.description: Type of nucleic acid used for sequencing
NUCLEIC_ACID_SOURCE.title: NucleicAcidSourceEnum

NUCLEI_BARCODE.description: Nuclei barcode sequence used to demultiplex reads to individual nuclei

NUCLEI_BARCODE_LENGTH.description: Length, in base pairs, of the nuclei barcode sequence

NUCLEI_BARCODE_READ.description: Sequencing read that contains the nuclei barcode sequence

NUCLEUS_IDENTIFIER.description: Unique nuclei barcode; added at transposition step. Determines which nucleus the reads originated from

REVERSE_TRANSCRIPTION_PRIMER.description: Primer used for reverse transcription. Applicable only to multiome / hybrid RNA+ATAC protocols; standard scATAC-seq has no reverse-transcription step and should leave this blank.
REVERSE_TRANSCRIPTION_PRIMER.title: ReverseTranscriptionPrimerEnum

SINGLE_CELL_ISOLATION_METHOD.description: Method used to isolate single cells
SINGLE_CELL_ISOLATION_METHOD.title: SingleCellIsolationMethodEnum

SPIKE_IN.description: Type of spike-in used, if any. Applicable only to multiome / hybrid RNA+ATAC protocols; standard scATAC-seq has no RNA spike-in and should leave this blank.
SPIKE_IN.title: SpikeInEnum

TOTAL_READS.description: Total number of reads collected from samtools.

TRANSPOSITION_REACTION.description: Name of the transposase, transposon sequences
TRANSPOSITION_REACTION.title: TranspositionReactionEnum
